quest.scrambled.start: Alan at the Tal Teok temple, north of Tal Teklan, approximately 1247,3167,0.
quest.scrambled.requirements: Children of the Sun; 38 Construction, 36 Cooking and 35 Smithing, all unboostable.
quest.scrambled.sequence: Alan's dropped egg; King's Inn; Acatzin and the repaired blacksmith whetstone/axe; Nezketi's damiana tea; Kauayotl's racing cart; King's three egg-recovery tasks; returning the eggs; egg jigsaw and final cutscene.
quest.scrambled.local_materials: Hammer from the smith's workshop; empty bowl from King's Inn; fountain water; Nezketi's cup; damiana leaves by the south-eastern walls; two planks south of Tal Teklan; saw from the archery shop; twenty iron nails on the smith's bench, six allocated to the cart with spare allowance for bent nails.
quest.scrambled.combat: Large chicken near 1238,3137; red dragon inside the Dragon Nest at about 1259,9482; black jaguar near 1332,3122. Fight actions are conditional on successful kills and egg pickups; dragonfire protection and food are real player considerations, but no invented universal food cost is imposed.
quest.scrambled.rewards: One quest point and 5,000 XP each in Construction, Cooking and Smithing. The optional post-quest egg and Alan's bones are not modeled as automatic rewards.

quest.shadows_of_custodia.requirements: Children of the Sun; 54 Slayer, 45 Fishing, 41 Construction and 36 Hunter, all unboostable.
quest.shadows_of_custodia.sequence: Question witnesses in Auburnvale; follow scratched wall and river clues; recover a wet cloth with a fishing rod; show the parents; track down and rescue the injured boys; arm Captain Ariadna's guards and reinforce the house; speak to the boys; return to the den, kill three strange creatures and escort Antos; report to the captain.
quest.shadows_of_custodia.materials: Four willow longbows are handed to Ariadna, four maple logs are consumed repairing the wall; a hammer is held during repair. Fishing rod spawns at the river. Willow bows can be purchased at Tal Teklan or elsewhere, and maple logs can be bought or harvested at 45 boostable Woodcutting. This draft uses one funded GE supply action instead of imposing Woodcutting as a quest requirement.
quest.shadows_of_custodia.rewards: Two quest points, 10,000 Slayer XP, 4,000 Hunter XP, 3,000 Fishing XP and 3,000 Construction XP. The Stalker Den becomes a permanent post-quest unlock.

review_gaps: The pinned helper declarations give waypoint candidates, not verified walking paths. Check Tal Teklan, Dragon Nest, Auburnvale, house upstairs and Stalker Den coordinates, door connectivity and reverse entries in the live game.
Cart nails may bend. The catalog provisions twenty iron nails but debits six as the nominal repair; record any additional consumption and stochastic retry behavior before independent review.

Verify the exact mechanics of reassembling the egg, whether retrieved eggs are consumed when presented, and any incidental Cooking/Smithing/Construction or combat XP before treating the path as reviewed.

The helper identifies three fights in Scrambled! and three strange creatures in Shadows. Success conditions are explicit, but combat gear, damage budgets, enemy immunity and rescue interruptions remain player-dependent.

Verify that Shadows' four bows are handed over at Captain Ariadna, that four maple logs are spent on the wall, and that the fishing rod spawn is available every time. Check alternative item sources for trade-restricted scenarios.
The price of the Shadows defence-kit GE supplies is an estimated one-time budget; verify live prices and the player's money availability before route optimization.
Neither quest is independently reviewed. Travel and dialogue durations are estimates; no claim of an unseeded full-account optimal route is made.
